main_classification.name: Classification

steps.text: Report to the Classification Hall in Civara.
Stabilise a resonance pattern.
Pass the combat assessment.

main_classification.summary: Custody or classification. Kai chose the road that keeps a door open, and the road leads to Civara.

main_greymere_day.name: A Day in Greymere

steps.text: Round up the goats Joey let loose.
Take Danfor's sparring lesson.
Hear Gell out at the shop.
Let Lena see to that scrape.
Answer Elder Silas.

main_greymere_day.summary: Joey has a bad idea. Danfor has a lesson. Gell has opinions, Lena has bandages and Silas has a question about the old ridge.

main_hollow_court.name: Into the Hollow Court

steps.text: Get down the Collapsed Stair.
Free Warden Almyra in the Drowned Gallery.
Reach Joey.
Break the seal on the passage.
Silence the Sealed Choir.

main_hollow_court.summary: The ridge gave way at dusk and Joey went down after his stash. If you hear something calling, do not answer it.

main_inspection.name: The Inspection

steps.text: Meet the inspection party in the square.
Find out what the cordon is for.

main_inspection.summary: Dogs bark at the hill and the well tastes of iron. Avelan has sent a Warden to inspect the ground under Greymere.

side_gell_crates.name: Gell's Delivery

steps.text: Carry the lamp oil to the inn.

side_gell_crates.summary: Gell owes the inn a crate of lamp oil and would rather not walk.

side_grey_wolf.name: The Grey Wolf

steps.text: Follow the tracks off the Route 01 road.
Face Old Greymaw at its den.

side_grey_wolf.summary: Old Ferris swears Old Greymaw is walking the ridge path again, and that the wolf only comes down before the frost.

side_joey_wager.name: Joey's Wager

steps.text: Beat the Wandering Challenger on Route 01.
Win the rematch Joey arranged.

side_joey_wager.summary: Joey has bet a stranger that you can beat the Wandering Challenger twice in one day. He did not ask first.

side_lena_herbs.name: Lena's Errand

steps.text: Gather marshwort by the pond on Route 01.
Bring the marshwort to Lena.

side_lena_herbs.summary: Lena needs marshwort from the reeds by the Route 01 pond.
